format.msb: MS.b 回调：键 = cmd(hex)；args={p1,l,s,o}；ret 为 Java 返回值
format.jni: metasec 直接发起的 JNI 调用：键 = 类.方法签名 / 字段签名；self = 调用对象（String 时有值）
format.值编码: String 原样；装箱类型 'Integer:5'；byte[] = {cls:'[B',len,hex[,txt][,file]}；基本类型数组 = {cls:'[I',v:[...]}；其他对象 {cls} 只是句柄
format.去重: 同一调用 + 同参数 + 同返回（含对象 id）只留一条，count = 出现次数；t_ms 为首次出现时刻

sysinfo._about: struct sysinfo as the recorded device reports it. metasec calls sysinfo() (import at 0x4c1060, call site 0x20c550) and multiplies totalram by mem_unit; unidbg answers NR 179 with nothing, so the guest sees the struct pointer as the return value and takes the failure branch. The handler in MetasecSyscalls fills the struct from this file.
sysinfo._note: byte counts = the kB values in /proc/meminfo * 1024; loads = loadavg * 65536; mem_unit = 1 (the kernel reports bytes)

network._about: the device's IPv4 interface. metasec builds the mssdk report field /#7/#5 ({"iip":..,"gip":..,"ghw":..,"type":..}) from SIOCGIFCONF + SIOCGIFFLAGS + an RTM_GETROUTE dump. unidbg answers SIOCGIFCONF from java.net.NetworkInterface, i.e. the host machine's adapters, so without this the emulated app would report the host's LAN address (and its adapter name) as the device's.

network._interfaces: the IPv4 interfaces in the kernel order (lo is registered first, index 1, 127.0.0.1/8 on every Linux device); wlan0 /24 from its broadcast 192.168.1.255. unidbg answered SIOCGIFCONF with wlan0 only and the netlink address dump with the host machine's adapters
network._gateway: the Wi-Fi gateway: MS.b(0x100001c) recorded ["192.168.1.1","0.0.0.0"] (DhcpInfo) and the device's mssdk report /#7/#11 and /#7/#5 gip; metasec reads it from an RTM_GETROUTE dump, answered from it (MetasecSyscalls.RouteDumpNetLink)
